Class CustomTagletBase

    • forceInit

      protected final void forceInit()

      Forces the initialisation of the inline tags.

      For some unknown reason it may happen that the inline tags are not yet registered in m_TagFunctions, causing an "error: unknown tag: …" message when used within another custom tag.

    • parseNameAndEmail

      protected final String parseNameAndEmail(Collection<? extends DocTree> tags)

      Parses the given tags for a name and an email address.

      The tag is prefixed with the tag text, and name and email address are separated by a hyphen ("-" or &#x2d;), surrounded by blanks.

      Parameters:
      tags - The tags.
      Returns:
      The formatted output.
